newsitem.title: USA: Golden Star begins trenching in Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Golden Star begins trenching in Kenya.

text.p: Golden Star Resources Ltd said its 58 percent owned Pan African Resources Corp unit has begun trenching in two areas of its 1,300 square kilometer Ndori property in Kenya.
The company said the sites, acquired in late 1996, were identified with termite mound sampling, noting this was done along with geologic mapping and sampling of old workings on the property.

The Ndori property encompasses Archaean greenstones of the northern extent of the Lake Victoria Gold District, similar geology to that across Lake Victoria in nearby Tanzania, which hosts world class gold deposits.

To date, 1,257 of the proposed 1,500 termite mound samples have been collected by Pan African, with assays available for 365 samples. The two significant areas of interest were defined by 58 of those samples, Golden Star said.
